text:
sophie: filing a small docs PR to update the model card for the new slim variant. scope: supported limits, quick bench highlights, compatibility note about quant routing, and two concise examples (python SDK v3 + curl).

ashley: throw in a clear note about >4096 seq fallback behavior (dedicated runtime has seen reroutes).

sophie: will add under Limits: "Sequences >4096 may trigger quantized fallback on constrained nodes."

mira: add a short embeddings sharding snippet and link to /docs/embeddings#shard-routing. snippet: `shard = hash(key) % shards; client.embeddings.create(model="slim-3b", input=[...], shard_id=shard)`

chris: mention that routing policy can map slim-3b to slim-3b-quant on low-memory hosts; note perf & minor quality delta.

sophie: adding: "Quantized fallback: ~1.2x latency, slight logit variance." will cite bench CSV.

docs-bot: bench CSV: https://bench.redwood.internal/slim-3b/latest.csv

sophie: inline bench highlights: p4d ~420 tok/s @512; g5 ~680 tok/s; quant fallback numbers included parenthetically.

ashley: SDK nit: use `max_tokens` not `length` in examples. add migration tip for v2 -> v3.

sophie: done. python example uses `client.generate(..., max_tokens=256)`. curl uses `max_tokens` param.

chris: i'll run MD linter and quick review after you open the PR.

sophie: branch refs/heads/docs/slim-card-update-1757777777 pushed. PR checklist in body: limits, bench link, embed shard snippet + anchor, sdk v3 snippet, curl example, compatibility note. reviewers: @ashley @mira @chris. aiming to merge tomorrow EOD.

paul: LGTM, will watch for the PR link.

mira: i'll validate the anchor and snippet when PR is up.

sophie: thanks all, posting PR in channel now when it's live. :rocket:
